notes: s001+s002 → 'Howbeit' is retained as a rule 30/35 fusion; the competing split (waw → 'Howbeit', which rule 14 lists among the waw connectives, with ʾûlām unrepresented) is named in the unit note and rejected because it would leave a lexical adverb with no English.
The 'to' of 'hearken to all my words' stays inside the verb's unit: the Hebrew object is bare, no marker or preposition morpheme competes, so rule 44 governs and the head stays on 'hearken'.
s013 is tagged Sh, not Sd, so rule 32's first sentence applies and the unit is unrepresented; the gloss 'ear.to' on it is the display defect rule 39 describes.
nāʾ takes the whole 'I pray thee' formula under rule 30's closing sentence; its pronouns are not added.
